name: Grilled Asian Pork Meatballs with Rice & Cucumber-Tomato-Carrot Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the lime juice.
Trim and mince green onions. Add half to the bowl with the lime juice (place remaining green onion in another large bowl and set aside for the salad).
Add pork, fish sauce, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the lime juice. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
2 tbsp fish sauce
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the pork mixture into 24 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long; place on a large plate.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs to the pan and grill, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the remaining green onion. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice cucumbers; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice, meatballs, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
